purpose: Test whether kinematically valid override windows plus event-level triggers and handback produce a genuinely useful, honestly accounted recovery mechanism before any recovery-focused training is authorized. Thresholds in this document are DRAFTS for the user to freeze; nothing here authorizes a probe run to consume formal authority.

v1.failure: Consecutive-streak triggers were too sparse and the shallow recovery boundary handed back too early: 0/12 intervention wins with 19 locally shallow recoveries.

v2.failure: Handback required stable_agreement_ticks=48 consecutive clean per-tick agreements. Under the measured 15-36% recovery-phase disagreement one clean window has probability (1-p)^48, approximately 4e-4 down to 1e-8 per window, so control almost never returned: the reported 73% teacher execution fraction was mathematically forced by the handback arithmetic, not observed autonomy.

v3.failure: Executed the teacher only on semantic-disagreement ticks inside the V2 recovery phase. The reported teacher fraction collapses to roughly the teacher non-wait density (2.2-2.9% of ticks) while the teacher still gates every fire decision: a denominator hack, not autonomy. Its 1-tick fire overrides are also motor-invalid: through the elite-human stack (reaction_delay_ticks=12, 6-tick fire animation) a fire intent issued at tick t releases its projectile near t+18 at the cursor angle parked by the surrounding student aim intents, so the overridden button fires at the student's angle.
v3.evidence_path: code analysis of tools/alphazuma_55_recovery_intervention_v3.py; bind a V3 probe completion here at freeze time if one was executed

source.selection_rule: frozen motor-observable V3 source baseline; no result-conditioned candidate substitution

teacher.construction: deterministic CurveAwareSettledStrategicRevengeTeacher built from each environment's teacher_spec(); no checkpoint file exists

level_selection_rule: the same pre-existing fixed 12-level cross-world panel as V1/V2/V3; no level was added or removed after observing earlier outcomes

paired_probe.execution_rule: when the controller decides the teacher acts (deep recovery or fire override), the teacher controls BOTH verb and aim on EVERY tick until the window closes; ALL window ticks count as teacher execution
paired_probe.fire_lock_rule: a window containing a teacher fire edge cannot close before edge + reaction_delay(12) + fire_animation(6) + release_margin(4) = 22 ticks, protecting the release from POST-commit student aim: no student intent issued after the window opens can reach the slew-limited cursor before the projectile samples it
paired_probe.fire_override_head_limitation: the lock does NOT retract pre-commit student aim: intents issued in the 12 ticks before the window opened are already in the reaction-delay pipeline and steer the cursor for the first 12 window ticks, leaving only ~6 teacher-driven ticks (<= ~32 bins, acceleration-limited less) before the ~t+18 release, so the FIRST override shot can release off-target; the W1 release-angle attribution records such shots as off-target teacher shots (shots_on_target_rate / release_angle_error_bins), so the probe observes this failure mode instead of hiding it
paired_probe.trigger_rule: deep recovery opens when 3 of the last 4 decision-relevant events (classify_tick from the closed-loop metrics module) are disagreements, or on the V2 score-stall / chain-growth triggers; a teacher fire the student omits or mis-aims opens a bounded fire-override window
paired_probe.handback_rule: 4 consecutive decision-relevant agreement events plus minimum window ticks and fire-lock expiry; protected student cooldown follows
paired_probe.handback_probability_note: 0.75^4 ~= 0.316 per window at 25% event-level disagreement, versus V2's (1-p)^48 ~= 4e-4..1e-8 which mathematically forced the 73% teacher fraction
paired_probe.veto_accounting: student fires suppressed during teacher windows are counted as student_fire_vetoes and reported in every episode row, mode summary, and completion
paired_probe.closed_loop_instrumentation: both modes report the W1 metrics: decision-relevant disagreement rates, wait-inclusive aim intent error, release-angle attribution across the 18-tick wrapped commit-to-release delay, shots_on_target_rate, and honest execution fractions

thresholds_to_freeze: source model and completion sha256 bindings

interpretation_boundary.pass_means: the override-window mechanism is useful enough AND honestly accounted enough to freeze a separate recovery-priority DAgger training pilot
interpretation_boundary.pass_does_not_mean: the student learned from the intervention or any candidate is promotable
interpretation_boundary.fail_means: do not train on this exact V4 intervention recipe

freeze_instructions: To freeze: bind every TO_BE_BOUND/TO_BE_FROZEN field with real paths and sha256 receipts, recompute the probe/controller/metrics hashes, set status to FROZEN_BEFORE_PROBE, then run tools/probe_alphazuma_55_recovery_intervention_v4.py with --preregistration pointing at the frozen document. A DRAFT_NOT_FROZEN document is accepted by the probe for engineering runs but is recorded as unfrozen in every receipt.
